programme.title: Mr. Vampire 3
programme.desc: A Taoist priest and his spirit companions must go separate ways after he decides to help a vampire-buster, who wants to defeat an evil witch and her henchmen.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: In 1990s China, a northern cop joins forces with a local detective in the southern city of Binhai to track down a ruthless gang responsible for a string of violent robberies. A battle of wits ensues between law enforcement and criminals.

programme.title: Challenge Of The Gamesters
programme.desc: Wong Jing created the gambling film genre almost singlehandedly, and in one of his earliest blockbusters, Shih Hsien leads a stellar cast in a tale of spies, tycoons and beautiful babes.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Small-time conman and mechanic Lolanto finds himself in trouble when he cheats gangster Yu Yan Tat out of his high-end sports car on a three-day loan, where new sparkplugs would have sufficed.

programme.title: Love In A Fallen City
programme.desc: A cynical playboy pursues an introverted divorcee in the decadence of Hong Kong on the eve of the 1941 Japanese invasion.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: When a young man ignores a feng shui master's warning and decides to marry before turning 30, a series of mishaps begins to curse his life.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: Brilliant director Sun Chung and the majestic Ti Lung reunite for a thriller about an aging fighter who relives his violent past mistakes through a streetwise kid.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Chow stars as Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey: Pandora's Box
programme.desc: A Monkey King is reincarnated in the un human form as Joker, a highwayman oblivious to his original identity and the fact that 500 years earlier, he and his master, the Longevity Monk, were punished and made to stay human.

programme.title: Out Of The Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. Freaked out by the haunting, the security guards invite ghostbuster Leo and his assistant to help.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: An imperial agent gets ridiculed for his various inventions, until his supportive wife encourages him to attend a conference, which's actually a trap to kill all the doctors serving the emperor, where his crazy inventions come in handy.

programme.title: Whisper Of Silent Body
programme.desc: Forensic pathologist Qin works with his assistant and the police captain to resolve the backlog of cases.

programme.title: Young Heroes Of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Taoist Priest isn't happy when his Buddhist Priest colleague moves in next door. They are subject to feuds and duels, but soon must overcome their problems when a vampire breaks loose from his coffin and wreaks havoc to the countryside.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: The film's story unfolds in the fictional country of Laika and in Hong Kong, China. A police academy student who has not yet graduated, Ashan (played by Gu Bin), is tasked with a dangerous mission. He helps the criminal organization by eliminating obstacles for their leader, Atian (played by An Zhi Jie), in prison. Ashan approaches Atian, gains his trust, and collects evidence against the criminal group. After both of them are released from prison, Ashan assists Atian in rising within the criminal organization in Hong Kong. After enduring numerous challenges, Atian successfully replaces the group's leader, Bao Ge (played by Zeng Zhiwei), becoming the new boss and taking control of the organization. However, just as Ashan is about to complete his mission, his true identity is exposed.

programme.title: Face To Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. Things change, when Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man at Tamotsu's funeral.

programme.title: How To Pick Girls Up!
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: The Dragon King is locked in a seal by the Dragon Master for 500 years, and his daughter must travel back in the past to kill the Dragon Master as she know that they were close friends back then.

programme.title: Let's Have A Baby
programme.desc: A charming tale of child-creating complications, featuring a rare comedic performance by Alex Man Chi-leung.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: Centering on Ip Man's migration to Hong Kong in 1949 as he attempts to propagate his discipline of Wing Chun martial arts.

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: Before winning action-film acclaim with their daring stunts, these stars endure years of blood, sweat, and tears training under the ruthless Master Yu.

programme.title: The Bare-Footed Kid
programme.desc: A young man arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Confession Of Pain
programme.desc: A detective helps a friend investigate the mysterious death of his father-in-law.

programme.title: From Beijing With Love
programme.desc: A Chinese spy who's been out of service for ten years whilst making a living as a butcher is sent to Hong Kong to locate a stolen Tyrannosaurus rex skull.

programme.title: Behind The Yellow Line
programme.desc: Behind The Yellow Line

programme.desc: Never take your mistress on an annual guys' getaway, especially one devoted to hunting - a violent lesson for three wealthy married men.

programme.desc: Set 4 years after movie Train To Busan. People on the Korean peninsula, who have survived from ruin, struggle to survive.

programme.title: The Swindlers (TVN Movies)
programme.desc: Unlikely allies from different sides of the law must work together to achieve a common goal trapping the world's most legendary con man.

programme.title: The Old Woman With The Knife (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: An aging assassin with a knack for taking out society's worst encounters a young protégé eager to learn the trade. As they form an unlikely bond, the veteran killer discovers fresh purpose in her twilight years of violence and routine.

programme.title: Once We Were Us
programme.desc: Two former lovers cross paths on a flight to Korea, stirring memories of their chance meeting in 2008, when they found love amid Seoul's chaos before life pulled them apart.

programme.title: Confession
programme.desc: A man who became a suspect in a closed-door murder seeks help from an attorney to prove him innocent. As they begin to piece the puzzle together, the truth slowly reverses.

programme.title: Streaming
programme.desc: Follows a mystery streamer with the largest number of subscribers, broadcasting the process of uncovering clues to an unsolved serial murder case in real time.

programme.title: Where Would You Like To Go?
programme.desc: A school teacher Do-kyeong (Jun Seok-ho) dies as he fails to save his student Ji-yong from drowning. After the two pass away, Do-kyeong's wife Myeong-ji (Park Ha-sun) and Ji-yong's sister Ji-eun are left alone in the world, having to cope with the loss of their loved ones. Myeong-ji travels to Warsaw, Poland, to stay distanced from her harsh reality and meets an old friend to whom she hides her husband's death as if she is trying to reject the tragedy. While she is unable to let him go, Ji-eun is hospitalized as her health condi- tion worsens. Lacking any enthusiasm for life, Ji-eun also struggles to recover. On the day of the Warsaw Uprising, where people commemorate the death of victims of their dark history, Myeong-ji returns to her home in Korea, where a letter from Ji-eun is awaiting.

programme.title: Oh! My Ghost
programme.desc: A comical horror movie portraying a late-year job seeker, Tae Min, who is able to see ghosts through his specs as he gets a job in a studio where mysterious incidents happen every night.

programme.title: Only God Knows Everything
programme.desc: After his ordination, Father Do-woon hears a confession revealing his mother’s 13-year disappearance. Bound by sacred secrecy and revenge, he sets out to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Life Is Beautiful
programme.desc: Se-yeon, devoted her entire life to her family, suddenly learns she is gravely ill. Now she is determined to live for herself more than ever and looks for her first love with the help of her husband.

programme.title: Boy In The Pool
programme.desc: A girl who loves swimming meets a boy with webbed feet and falls in love with him. Over time, the girl gets conflicted between cheering for the boy as a promising swimmer and keeping herself from an inferiority complex.

programme.title: Dr. Cheon And The Lost Talisman
programme.desc: Dr. Cheon is a fake exorcist who cannot see or hear any ghosts. One day, a woman comes to Dr. Cheon, asking him to save her possessed younger sister.
